export: RIDOT Office of Safety statewide crash repository extract, as delivered on an APRA request
spec: State of Rhode Island Uniform Crash Report (rev 12/06, NHTSA copy https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/documents/ri_par_rev_12_06_sub_02_08_07.pdf, pages 1-8 incl. Coding Guide) and RIDOT Traffic Design Manual 2025, 7.1.1.1 Crash Summary, pp. 7-1 to 7-2 (~/.hermes/state-manuals/ri/RIDOT_Traffic_Design_Manual_2025.pdf). No database field dictionary is published.
unit: form: crash page + vehicle pages + occupants/witnesses/pedestrians page (Unit ID, Injury), keyed by Report Number. The repository's table split is unknown.

map.county_code: derived from city/town (RI has 39 towns, 5 counties)
map.secondary_road: intersecting street (the form's location block; name not readable in the published copy)
map.sec_distance: not confirmed in the published form
map.sec_direction: not confirmed in the published form
map.lat_lon: NOT documented. Ask RIDOT for latitude/longitude. Without it every crash is placed from street + cross street (TIGER Providence County 44007 etc.)
map.property: State Property / City/Town Property / Private Property (drop private property, as CCRS does)
map.severity: crash-level KABCO (TDM 2025 p. 7-2: 'severity ... based on the KABCO severity index ... most severe injury sustained'); person Injury column on page 6. Crash Facts also has 'Unknown' (5.5% in 2025) -> U
map.is_freeway: derived: Street or Highway is I-95, I-195, I-295, RI 4, RI 146 (controlled access) or a ramp
map.pedestrian: Occupants - Witnesses - Pedestrians - Bicyclists page, person type
